scope: Extended and Outcomes Scientific Base content population. No item wording, scoring keys, thresholds, norms, participant labels or restricted adjudication details.
global_claim_boundary: Internal architecture verification and external adjacent literature are distinct evidence classes. Neither is empirical psychometric validation of the integrated P-120 module. Candidate construct labels remain candidate unless a source authority separately upgrades them.

research_question.ru: Как человек выражает, получает, уточняет, согласовывает и восстанавливает сексуально или эротически значимую коммуникацию?
research_question.en: How does a person express, receive, clarify, negotiate and repair sexually or erotically meaningful communication?

role.ru: Отдельный процессуальный слой межличностной эротической коммуникации. Он не подменяет мотивацию, привязанность, внутреннее авторство выбора, содержание предпочтений или downstream-исходы.
role.en: A distinct interpersonal erotic-communication process layer. It does not substitute for motivation, attachment, internal authorship of choice, preference content or downstream outcomes.

modules.development_record: 32-item development pool → 24-item Cognitive Candidate; item-level red-team, ownership firewalls and controlled C1/C2/C3 field/evidence-adjudication protocol completed at architecture level; actual field evidence remains required before freeze adjudication.
modules.internal_evidence: E1 — construct-boundary, redundancy, ownership and response-process architecture controlled.
modules.empirical_state: E2 PENDING — actual cognitive/field observations not supplied as completed evidence in the current authority set.
modules.external_anchor_role: Sexual-communication meta-analytic context, measurement precedent, sexual-assertiveness boundary comparator and prior self-disclosure literature.
key_boundaries: COM-N ≠ SELF-SAA: interpersonal negotiation ≠ internal authorship
COM-P ≠ P-72D erotic recovery: conversational repair ≠ erotic re-engagement
COM-P ≠ LIFE-CCO: repair capacity ≠ downstream cognitive carryover
COM ≠ AO: communication process ≠ attachment/security regulation
COM ≠ MOT: how information is communicated ≠ why intimacy is chosen
modules.publication_ceiling: Candidate communication architecture + development history + verification methods + selected evidence anchors + current field gate. No confirmed factor structure, COM Total, production scoring, norms, diagnosis or consent-validity classification.

research_question.ru: Почему — ради какого ожидаемого психологического результата — человек выбирает сексуально или эротически значимую близость?
research_question.en: Why — for what anticipated psychological result — does a person choose sexual or erotically significant intimacy?

role.ru: Слой причин выбора близости, отделённый от силы желания, триггеров активации, поведения, коммуникационной способности, самоотношения и последующих состояний.
role.en: A layer of reasons for choosing intimacy, separated from desire strength, activation triggers, behavior, communication ability, self-relation and downstream states.

modules.development_record: Evidence/boundary audit → 36-item controlled initial pool → 24-item Cognitive Candidate + 12-item traceable desk reserve → expert/CVI/cognitive pre-pilot architecture ready for execution.
modules.internal_evidence: E1 — desire ≠ activation ≠ motivation ≠ behavior distinction, item-level reduction, ownership firewalls, scope/exposure contract and information-gain requirements controlled.
modules.empirical_state: E2 PENDING — expert/CVI and respondent cognitive evidence must be collected and adjudicated before structural freeze.
modules.external_anchor_role: Sexual-motive taxonomy, approach/avoidance goals, approach-goal desire maintenance, communal motivation and autonomy/partner-responsive context.
key_boundaries: MOT ≠ P-72/P-72D: why engage ≠ what activates/how activation changes
MOT-C ≠ AO: closeness goal ≠ standing attachment regulation
MOT-V ≠ SELF-PSD/SRG/SSH: validation-seeking motive ≠ standing self-appraisal
MOT-K ≠ LIFE: antecedent regulation motive ≠ observed downstream state
M0 ≠ low desire: low motive access does not establish low sexual desire
modules.publication_ceiling: Candidate motive territories and development evidence only. No MOT Total, healthy/unhealthy motive classification, confirmed factor model, production scoring or psychometric-validity claim.

research_question.ru: Как человек переживает, оценивает и авторизует себя как сексуального субъекта?
research_question.en: How does a person experience, evaluate and author themselves as a sexual subject?

role.ru: Слой сексуального самоотношения, не сводимый к общей самооценке, образу тела, коммуникации, мотивации, привязанности, телесной чувствительности или предпочтениям.
role.en: A sexual self-relation layer that is not reducible to general self-esteem, body image, communication, motivation, attachment, embodied sensitivity or preferences.

modules.development_record: 12 initial territories → pruning/ownership adjudication → 5 CORE + 2 LIMITED candidate architecture → controlled item pool → 21-item Cognitive Candidate → expert/CVI/cognitive evidence-gathering architecture.
modules.internal_evidence: E1 — construct pruning, survivor ledger, cross-module ownership, explicit dissociation requirements and red-team collision programme controlled.
modules.empirical_state: E2 PENDING — PASS 6 controls evidence-gathering architecture, not completed expert/CVI/cognitive results.
modules.external_anchor_role: Sexual self-schema, sexual subjectivity, multidimensional sexual self-concept, self-consciousness and measurement-review precedents. These sources support adjacent construct territory and comparator logic, not the P-120 factor structure.
key_boundaries: SAA ≠ COM-N: internal authorship ≠ interpersonal negotiation
SAA ≠ P-72D SEA/AUT: self-authorship ≠ initiative/durability or differentiation for erotic tension
SSC ≠ SOMA: evaluative self-focus ≠ embodied signal processing
SSH ≠ AO: sexual shame ≠ attachment threat
PSD ≠ MOT-V: desirability self-appraisal ≠ validation-seeking motive
SBA ≠ SOMA/RPE: own-body appraisal ≠ embodied sensitivity or preferred anatomy
modules.publication_ceiling: 5 CORE + 2 LIMITED candidate architecture, development and evidence-gathering record, boundaries and selected evidence anchors. No SELF Total, confirmed seven-factor model, norms or participant interpretation.

research_question.ru: Какие специфические preference/reward coordinates могут добавлять информацию, не дублируя активацию, телесный отклик, коммуникацию, самоотношение или outcomes?
research_question.en: Which specific preference/reward coordinates may add information without duplicating activation, embodied response, communication, self-relation or outcomes?

role.ru: Опциональный специализированный слой предпочтений и reward architecture под отдельным safety/privacy и publication governance.
role.en: An optional specialized preference/reward layer under separate safety/privacy and publication governance.

key_boundaries: preference ≠ activation
preference ≠ embodied response
preference ≠ communication capacity
preference ≠ downstream benefit

research_question.ru: Какие более широкие аффективные, энергетические, когнитивные, восстановительные, вовлекающие или смысловые состояния наблюдаются вокруг и после близости?
research_question.en: What broader affective, energetic, cognitive, restorative, engagement or meaning-related states are observed around and after intimacy?

role.ru: Отдельный outcome/spillover layer. LIFE измеряет наблюдаемые downstream-состояния, а не психосексуальную черту и не причинный эффект близости.
role.en: A separate outcome/spillover layer. LIFE measures observed downstream states, not a psychosexual trait and not a causal effect of intimacy.

candidate_architecture: GLS — Global Life Satisfaction [EXTERNAL ANCHOR, not proprietary core]
modules.temporal_architecture: Event/daily T0 and T1, recent-pattern and global/external-anchor modes are not interchangeable; exposure/opportunity/eligibility and N/A states remain explicit.

key_boundaries: MOT-K ≠ LIFE: reason for intimacy ≠ downstream state
AO ≠ LIFE-NAL/CCO: attachment regulation ≠ broader affect/cognition
